messages:
gita: quick thread  prototype showing compact trace row with actions: copy id, open trace, download. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/compact-trace-row
owen: looks clean. main concern: copy affordance is small and sits under hover-only tooltip in current frames. not great for keyboard/sr users.
sam: agree. proposal: always-visible 8-char micro-id + a 16px copy button next to it. copy action shows inline non-reflow 'Copied' for 1s and aria-live announces success.
aisha: must ensure the copy button is in tab order before overflow. tooltip optional but must have aria-describedby. avoid hover-only reveals.
peggy: for the download action, change label from 'Export' to 'Download trace (JSON)'. add short explanatory line: 'Includes spans and tags. Enable logs to attach raw request logs (may increase size)'.
ogen: typo: "ogen"? (typo in earlier message)
gita: oops, ignore.
owen: also suggest micro-menu on the copy icon (accessible via Alt+Down) with options: Copy id, Copy link (24h). default Enter = Copy id.
aisha: announce when expiring link copied: 'Expiring trace link copied, expires in 24 hours'. include role=status live region.
sam: analytics: fire events copy_id, copy_link, download_confirmed with trace_id and size_estimate.
ux-bot: checklist: keyboard nav, screen-reader readthrough, focus order, color contrast, reduced-motion for expand. run automated a11y scan before merge.
gita: thanks all  i'll update the frames and push soon.
